owner: syncPublicProfile trigger, in the same transaction as publicProfiles
sharedWriterReason: The profile projector (profiles) writes it in the same transaction as publicProfiles, and account deletion (safety) deletes it at the start of deletion, as it does publicProfiles.
read: server only; the matching-feed callables read it with the admin SDK and return it to the guests they chose

newCollectionRationale.whyNotAnExistingCollection: The sensitive dating answers must be readable only by guests the server has chosen (co-guests and matching-feed members), never by organisers or any signed-in account. publicProfiles is readable by every signed-in account and rules cannot hide its fields, and users holds private account data the feeds must not return.

migrationNotes: Issue #2493 (FIX-8). Added 24 Nov 2026 as the server-only home of the full dating profile; publicProfiles narrows to a card in a later step. The guest-profiles migration in tool/data/migrate_firestore_consolidation.mjs copies existing publicProfiles here.
